    //==
    // # Hole bridging
    //
    // A hole is joined to the ring around it by a BRIDGE: a pair of coincident
    // edges between the hole's leftmost vertex and a ring vertex that can see it,
    // traversed once in each direction. Splicing along a bridge turns a ring plus a
    // hole into a single ring ear clipping can consume, which is why holes never
    // reach the clipping pass as holes.
    //
    // The bridge is found by Eberly's method: cast a ray towards -X from the hole's
    // leftmost vertex, take the ring edge it meets first, then check whether any
    // reflex ring vertex hides that edge's corner from the hole.
    // https://www.geometrictools.com/Documentation/TriangulationByEarClipping.pdf

    // Where the ray towards -X from `p` meets the ring edge leaving `slot`, or
    // Number.MinValue when that edge does not cross it at or to the left of `p`.
    // Only downward edges count, so a ray through a shared vertex is not counted
    // twice.
    LeftwardHit(points: Array<Point2D>, nodes: Buffer<EarClipNode>,
        slot: Integer, p: Point2D): Number
    {
        var a = points.NodePoint(nodes, slot);
        var b = points.NodePoint(nodes, nodes.At(slot).Next);
        var crosses = a.Y >= p.Y && p.Y >= b.Y && a.Y != b.Y;
        var x = crosses ? a.X + (p.Y - a.Y) * (b.X - a.X) / (b.Y - a.Y) : p.X + 1.0;
        return crosses && x <= p.X ? x : Number.MinValue;
    }

    // Eberly's refinement. The corner the ray reached is visible unless a reflex
    // vertex of the ring lies in the wedge between the ray and that corner; among
    // those that do, the bridge goes to the one whose direction from the hole makes
    // the smallest angle with the ray, ties going to the rightmost.
    VisibleSlot(points: Array<Point2D>, nodes: Buffer<EarClipNode>, head: Integer,
        seed: Integer, holeSlot: Integer, rayX: Number): Integer
    {
        var hole = points.NodePoint(nodes, holeSlot);
        var corner = points.NodePoint(nodes, seed);
        var wedgeNear = Point2D(hole.Y < corner.Y ? hole.X : rayX, hole.Y);
        var wedgeFar = Point2D(hole.Y < corner.Y ? rayX : hole.X, hole.Y);
        var wedge = Triangle2D(wedgeNear, corner, wedgeFar);
        var best = seed;
        var bestTangent = Number.MaxValue;
        var slot = head;
        var stepped = false;
        while (stepped.Not || slot != head)
        {
            stepped = true;
            var c = points.NodePoint(nodes, slot);
            if (hole.X >= c.X && c.X >= corner.X && hole.X != c.X && wedge.Contains(c))
            {
                var tangent = (hole.Y - c.Y).Abs / (hole.X - c.X);
                if (points.LocallyInside(nodes, slot, holeSlot)
                    && (tangent < bestTangent
                        || (tangent == bestTangent
                            && c.X > points.NodePoint(nodes, best).X)))
                {
                    best = slot;
                    bestTangent = tangent;
                }
            }
            slot = nodes.At(slot).Next;
        }
        return best;
    }

    // The slot of the ring through `head` that the vertex at `holeSlot` bridges to,
    // or -1 when the ray escapes the ring — only possible when the declared
    // containment invariant is broken.
    BridgeSlot(points: Array<Point2D>, nodes: Buffer<EarClipNode>,
        head: Integer, holeSlot: Integer): Integer
    {
        var hole = points.NodePoint(nodes, holeSlot);
        var seed = -1;
        var rayX = Number.MinValue;
        var slot = head;
        var stepped = false;
        while (stepped.Not || slot != head)
        {
            stepped = true;
            var next = nodes.At(slot).Next;
            var x = points.LeftwardHit(nodes, slot, hole);
            if (x > rayX)
            {
                rayX = x;
                seed = points.NodePoint(nodes, slot).X < points.NodePoint(nodes, next).X
                    ? slot : next;
            }
            slot = next;
        }
        return seed < 0 ? -1 : points.VisibleSlot(nodes, head, seed, holeSlot, rayX);
    }

    // Splices the hole ring through `holeSlot` into the ring through `bridgeSlot`,
    // spending the two free slots at `free` and `free + 1` on the duplicated bridge
    // vertices. Both rings must already be wound as the conventions require, which
    // is what makes the spliced ring simple.
    Bridge(bridgeSlot: Integer, nodes: Buffer<EarClipNode>, holeSlot: Integer,
        free: Integer): Buffer<EarClipNode>
    {
        var bridge = nodes.At(bridgeSlot);
        var hole = nodes.At(holeSlot);
        var afterBridge = nodes.At(bridge.Next).WithPrev(free);
        var beforeHole = nodes.At(hole.Prev).WithNext(free + 1);
        var result = nodes.Set(free,
            EarClipNode(bridge.Vertex, free + 1, bridge.Next, true));
        result = result.Set(free + 1,
            EarClipNode(hole.Vertex, hole.Prev, free, true));
        result = result.Set(bridge.Next, afterBridge).Set(hole.Prev, beforeHole);
        return result.Set(bridgeSlot, bridge.WithNext(holeSlot))
            .Set(holeSlot, hole.WithPrev(bridgeSlot));
    }

    // Bridges every hole into the outer ring, left to right. A hole emptied by
    // cleanup, or one whose bridge search escapes, is left out: the first encloses
    // nothing, the second cannot be reached from the boundary.
    BridgeHoles(points: Array<Point2D>, nodes: Buffer<EarClipNode>,
        holeStarts: Array<Integer>): Buffer<EarClipNode>
    {
        var result = nodes;
        var order = points.HolesLeftToRight(holeStarts);
        var free = points.Count;
        var k = 0;
        while (k < order.Count)
        {
            var hole = order[k];
            var holeHead = holeStarts.RingStart(hole + 1)
                .FirstLiveSlot(result, holeStarts.RingEnd(hole + 1, points.Count));
            if (holeHead >= 0)
            {
                var outerHead = 0.FirstLiveSlot(result, holeStarts.RingEnd(0, points.Count));
                var holeSlot = points.LeftmostSlot(result, holeHead);
                var bridgeSlot = points.BridgeSlot(result, outerHead, holeSlot);
                if (bridgeSlot >= 0)
                {
                    result = bridgeSlot.Bridge(result, holeSlot, free);
                    free = free + 2;
                }
            }
            k = k + 1;
        }
        return result;
    }
